summary: Comprehensive testing of CAPEX Portal iteration 26 changes: Cosmos theme login (NO demo credentials, NO AES/JWT/RBAC badges, NO bearing text), Admin-only theme management, Settings page theme notice, Admin CRUD for Plants/Departments/Users, Sample status dialogs (Under Preparation with date picker, Ready for Dispatch with material fields/packing/gate pass), and Buyer decision flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 26 features tested and working. Login page has cosmos theme with nebula clouds, twinkling stars, shooting stars, and galaxy swirl effect. NO demo credentials, NO bearing/precision/industrial text, NO AES/JWT/RBAC badges. Settings page shows 'Theme is managed by the Admin from the Admin Panel' with no theme picker for regular users. Admin Dashboard has Themes tab with 14 theme options. Admin can CRUD Plants, Departments, and Users. Sample action dialogs working: Under Preparation dialog has date picker (data-testid='readiness-date-input'), Ready for Dispatch dialog has material description, code, quantity, packing type dropdown, and gate pass toggle with file upload. Buyer decision dialog shows Job Work Challan and Gate Pass options when sample is Ready for Dispatch and gate_pass=NO.
